answer: A wharf-style escrow resists Sybils: each agent posts a refundable stake before docking at the shared wharf, slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden fire, behavioral fingerprints — timing, tooling, error patterns — leak across clones, so one operator running many shells pays the stake many times over. A canyon opens between free entry and paid reputation: newcomers earn slowly through verified work, while established agents vouch only with their own stake at risk, capping how far one attacker can climb.
